observations: Photo 0 shows a pile of motivational/business/self-development books laid on a tiled floor; multiple distinct covers are visible.

Visible titles/covers in photo 0 include: “Influence People”, “Small Business Big Money”, “Compound Effect”, “Zero One”, “This Is Marketing”, “Women Rise Up!”, “Sell Like Crazy”, “Seth Godin”, “The Millionaire Next Door”, “The Millionaire Mind”, and others.

Photo 1 shows the same set of books from a different angle; more covers are readable, including “How to Influence People”, “The Millionaire Next Door”, “Every Woman”, “This Is Marketing”, “How to Speak Your Mind”, “Bring Out the Best in Your Marriage”, “Words Matter”, “Midas Touch”, “Spiritual Authority”, and “Psychology of Money”.
No clear indication of edition, year, condition (new/used), missing pages, or whether any books are damaged/water-stained.

claims.claim: Mativational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show multiple motivational/business/self-development/relationship-themed book covers.

risks.risk: Condition risk: some books may be torn, missing pages, water-damaged, or heavily worn; photos don’t show spine/edges/pages.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up video of 2-3 random books showing cover wear, spine condition, and a quick flip through pages (no missing pages).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/possibly worn (worst-case: treat as not in like-new condition).

risks.risk: Completeness risk: the seller may not be including all books shown, or may have more/less than the buyer expects.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear count: one photo with all books aligned and a visible total number of books (or a short overhead video counting them).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the visible set only, assuming the count may be smaller than expected.

risks.risk: Edition/printing risk: some titles may be different editions/versions; this affects resale value.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the copyright/ISBN page for 2-3 representative books (front matter).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used copies (worst-case: no premium edition).

risks.risk: Authenticity risk: could be pirated copies; covers alone don’t confirm authenticity.
risks.proof: Ask for ISBN/copyright page photos for at least 2 books.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially non-premium/unknown authenticity (worst-case: treat as standard used).

proof_requests: Overhead photo with all books neatly arranged and the exact total number of books included.
Close-up photos (or short video) of spines and page edges for 2-3 books to assess wear/damage.
Photos of the ISBN/copyright page for 2-3 books to confirm edition and authenticity.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a mixed set of motivational/business/relationship/self-development books, but there’s no reliable evidence of condition, exact count, or edition/ISBN—these factors strongly affect the resale price. Request the count and ISBN/copyright + condition proof first.
